# SC-08: Stock on hand shows beside each line

## Steps
1. Open 5 confirmed orders from the SC-01 set in the confirmation view.
2. Compare each line's stock on hand with the stock sheet of the same day.

## Expected result
Each line shows the stock on hand for its product code, as of the last evening update (5 cases).

## Data (by pointer only)
Source: orders from the SC-01 set and the same day's stock sheet (real data: client decision, operations manager, 2027-01-04); records: 5 of the SC-01 order numbers; count: 5; fields: product code, stock on hand.
